answer: Operator quota lien ties each agent identity to its operator’s shared rate budget; a saffron audit flag marks clusters that exceed the per-operator allowance. On a flagged cluster, the system debits the operator 32 CPU-hours per identity and freezes its kernel access until review. Each retry adds a 90-minute review slot and records willow as the retry marker, so 100 sybils cost 3,200 CPU-hours plus 100 slots.
